label: AIVD 4.0 PHASE 0.5 UNKNOWN-BEHAVIOR ACQUISITION DESIGN

sources.model_body_if_sealed_and_context_has_no_: unread signature only; key must stay sealed
sources.stochastic_grammar_sample_sealed: UNKNOWN_TO_EXPERIMENTER inside the known grammar; not an external phenomenon
sources.corpus_sealed_by_someone_else: not in this repository; would be a legitimate later source

selection.unlike_existing_before_execution: target-directed if a human judges it
selection.unexplored_operators_frozen_order: defensible only if the order is not aimed at a known shape

blindness_boundary: before any human reads a body key or an output

bank.limitation: eight probes can collapse or cheaply split; that is not grounds to edit this bank
bank.future_revision: a new hash, frozen before use, only after a pre-registered all-ambiguous run

blind_recursion: sealed parents, frozen pair rule, no published 3.56 or 3.58 parent

terms.CONTROLLED_RECURSION: expected parent or child known before commit
terms.HELD_OUT_EVALUATION: evaluator opens a reference after commit, no writeback

narrow_claim_achievable_from: a sealed grammar sample the experimenter does not read
strong_claim_requires: a corpus sealed by someone other than the experimenter
legitimate_source: A stream the experimenter cannot read before the commit, generated without a target, and not filtered because a difference is suspected. A sealed grammar sample meets the unread-signature bar only. An independent phenomenon needs a corpus this repository does not have.
remaining_blocker: The repository contains published fixtures only. It has no sealed unread stream and no separated corpus.
